info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Backup Registry Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Creates a backup policy (an RPO, an RTO, a retention and a restore test interval), reads and lists it, reports a successful backup, the same run again (200, the stored one), a failed backup with a reason from the fixed list and a successful restore test, and shows how the policy judges itself when read: protection OK inside the RPO, the last run moving with a failure while the last success stays, the recovery time objective met or missed by the last restore test, a paused policy not judged. It updates the definition, pauses and resumes the policy, lists runs newest first with filters and a limit, and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves the registry is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-BKP-00403 on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long name, missing asset, numbers out of range, an RPO shorter than the frequency, malformed identifiers, missing tenant or executor), duplicate names (409) on create and on rename, illegal transitions, updating a paused policy, runs that are inconsistent (a failed run without a reason, a success with one, finishing before the start or in the future, a negative size, a reason that is free text), a run for a policy that is not the tenant's, tenant isolation, limits of the run list, and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (bkpOrganisationId). A policy breaching its RPO as time passes is proved by the unit tests of the domain (a policy cannot be backdated); the race of simultaneous reports of one run, the summary that only moves forward, two people pausing at once and the ledger are proved by the platform smoke (backup-smoke).
